title: UPS Foundation Professor of Business Logistics Co-Unit Head, Technology and Operations Management
bio: The New Science of Retailing How Analytics Are Transforming the Supply Chain and Improving Performance Authors Marshall Fisher and Ananth Raman, argue that the time is ripe for “rocket science retailing.” Just as Wall Street was transformed in the 1970’s by the influx of physicists, engineers, and “rocket scientists” with mathematical techniques that allowed the harnessing of vast, complicated transaction data, so too retailing is now ready, and in fact beginning a “rocket science revolution.”
